spatial_entity.notes: Historical Korean polity; claim is restricted to the documented 369 CE captive-distribution event.

claim.date_text_original: King Geunchogo year 24, ninth month (369 CE)
claim.summary: The Samguk sagi records that Baekje forces captured more than 5,000 people after defeating Goguryeo troops at Chiyang in 369 and distributed the captives among commanders and soldiers. The National Institute of Korean History interprets this episode as war captives being made nobi and distributed as rewards. This is strong evidence for a bounded captive-enslavement event, not by itself for prevalence across Baekje society.

territorial_practice.notes: P1 is deliberately bounded to the documented 369 event. The large captive count does not mechanically determine territorial prevalence.
